title: tool_approval_review_response
description: Your verdict on the pending tool call, and why. Call this exactly once, when you have decided.

verdict.description: allow: the call runs now, without asking the human. ask: it goes to the human with your reason. deny: it is rejected and the calling agent is told not to retry it.

reason.description: 1-3 sentences tied to this specific call: the concrete risk, or the concrete reason it is safe. Shown to the human on ask and to the calling agent on deny.
examples: `make test` runs the project's own test suite inside the workspace and changes nothing outside it.
